limitations: False-instance hiding for actual statement-derived Hair-Sahai source remains unproved.

CMV theorem is formally polynomial-time, not an arbitrary-QPT theorem.

new_results: Public Hair-Sahai anchor-one affine slice is a fixed MinRank public key whose every ORIGINAL rank-one witness decrypts the same structured bit.

Exact complete-output Fourier law P0_hat(Lambda)=2^(-r rank(N_Lambda)) for sum-of-r rank-one randomizer.
Information-theoretic false hiding reduces to one explicit rank-spectrum chi-square sum.
Arbitrary-QPT bit-prediction source extraction follows from low/high rank-spectrum conditions using Run102's one-copy mixed-advice Fourier sampler.
